random_sample.note: time-boxed: picks until the next pass is due; deck = whole catalog shuffled, no repeats per round
random_sample.host_weights_note: new apps a day when sampling (2026-11-01 estimate): primaries ~8 (631) / ~16 (629) after canaries and the update path, sample-only hosts ~50; re-set from real speed after a week; pool = each pool slot (a GitHub macOS runner, 2026-11-04: guessed at 636's speed)

Run soak/cleanup-chrome-orphan.ps1 on 629 after each cycle.

stuck._doc: stuck.py: a queue whose oldest activity waited this long is stuck; restart_hosts get an MDM restart (max per day), others only an alert. 635 is the physical NucBox people use (it hosts the findings VM): alert only.

disk._doc: disk.py: a soak host below min_gb free alerts once ("Soak host low on disk" issue); it clears once back above min_gb + hysteresis_gb.
